Bug_Title: InputSteam.read() implementation should not return a signed byte
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the read() method of the BuggyInputStream class. The method returns a signed byte value, which is not compliant with the InputStream contract. The buggy line is highlighted with a comment.
Trigger_Explanation: The InputSteam.read() method returns a signed byte value, which is not allowed according to the Java documentation. The method should return an unsigned byte value instead.
